steps: Start with a free online Linux course (e.g., Linux Foundation's Intro to Linux) to build foundational OS skills.
Take a beginner C++ course on Codecademy or Coursera to learn programming basics.
Enroll in a secure coding workshop (e.g., OWASP's free training) to understand security principles.
Practice software development by building a small project (e.g., a grade tracker) using C++ on Linux.
Combine your teaching skills with tech by creating a lesson plan that uses AI tools for classroom management.
